ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with an estimated 95:5 ratio of dark pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels from scars and barnacles.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity field across the ventral surface; high-intensity white clusters localized at distal tips; discrete white linear vectors distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle estimated at 35 degrees and high bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with high-frequency variations; irregular high-amplitude peaks at the distal tips caused by biological encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme left and right terminal edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the left lobe and more sparsely on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive acorn barnacle colonization on distal tips; widespread linear rake marks (scars) on the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Massive terminal barnacle encrustations creating irregular, thickened geometric profiles at the fluke tips.
